implementation_reuse.rule: Training and inference code is executed verbatim from saved code cells of notebooks 03, 04, 05 and 06; only training-log output paths are redirected to Results/additional so frozen artifacts are not overwritten.
implementation_reuse.frozen_configuration_rule: the notebook 05 namespace receives GraphConfig(**frozen['graph_config']) and ablation_configs() of it

seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of first-run probability p and tail hazard q across seeds

joint_forecast_decomposition.holm_family: AlphaProg-AGMT versus each comparator on LogLoss, Tail NLL and Effort NLL (9 tests)

decision_analysis.failure_support: net benefit of flagging likely first-run failure, thresholds 0.30-0.80; tabulated at 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7
decision_analysis.long_effort: identify first visits needing more than 5 runs using P(T > 5) = (1 - p)(1 - q)^4; censored records with fewer than 5 runs are excluded

censoring_and_hazard.informative_censoring: learner-fold out-of-fold LightGBM (frozen settings) predicting censoring among failed first runs
censoring_and_hazard.life_table: observed tail hazard by run index versus mean predicted q in the risk set, runs 2-10
censoring_and_hazard.run_varying_hazard: logit(q_r) = logit(q) + gamma_g, run groups 2, 3, 4, 5, 6-10, 11+, gamma estimated on validation, evaluated on test
censoring_and_hazard.stratified_ipcw: reverse Kaplan-Meier censoring curves within section group x history availability

structural_limits.graph_node_limit: descriptive: share of programs and history steps above 64 nodes

gate_variants.constant_gate: adaptive=False, grid L2 {0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01} x prior {0.2, 0.5}, chosen on validation
gate_variants.separate_gates: one gate for p (primary loss) and one for q (1 x tail loss), frozen L2 and prior

three_seed_ablations.seed_17_source: notebook 05 and 06 predictions of the frozen configuration
three_seed_ablations.holm_family: each variant versus AlphaProg-AGMT, separately for LogLoss and Effort NLL (7 tests each)

auxiliary_weight_sensitivity.scope: GraphTrajectory expert, full-training fit, three seeds

next_school_year_split.training: original training learners, queries starting before the cutoff
next_school_year_split.evaluation: original locked-test learners, queries starting on or after the cutoff
next_school_year_split.settings: frozen hyperparameters; gate refitted on new out-of-fold predictions with frozen L2 and prior

unseen_task_split.assignment: tasks stratified by curriculum level, ordered by training frequency, assigned in rotation
unseen_task_split.training: original training learners, queries on tasks outside the fold
unseen_task_split.evaluation: original locked-test learners, queries on tasks inside the fold
unseen_task_split.unknown_task_encoding: held-out task identifiers map to the reserved unknown index; task descriptors and the reference-solution graph of the task remain available
unseen_task_split.limitation: programs of held-out tasks can appear in learners' prior histories

neural_convergence.selection: best epoch by validation LogLoss; test reported at epoch 8 and at the selected epoch

matched_inputs.LightGBM-Sequence: frozen LightGBM settings with the 30 per-episode process channels of the last 8 prior attempts added

code_aware_kt.model: Code-DKT-type re-implementation from the published description (code2vec-style AST path attention combined with DKT); not the authors' code
code_aware_kt.budget: 8 epochs, width 64, batch 512, as for DKT

standardized_cost.neural_training: one epoch measured, eight-epoch cost reported as an explicit extrapolation

test_independence: not independent: the test split had been evaluated before this configuration was selected

execution_record.device: Windows 11, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu128; graph training with deterministic CUDA kernels
runs: full execution with all post hoc fits on this computer
execution_record.notebook_validation: 56 of 56 code cells executed in order; no error or stream outputs
